llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must create a route in the stack and present it as a modal screen (for example via native-stack `presentation` modal option).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Compose screen is registered inside a group with `screenOptions: { presentation: 'modal' }` in the native-stack navigator.
evidence: Modal: { screenOptions: { presentation: 'modal' }, screens: { Compose: { screen: ComposeScreen, ... } } }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Cancel action in compose must dismiss back to notes (for example with `navigation.goBack()`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: handleCancel calls `navigation.goBack()`, which dismisses the modal back to the Notes screen.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Save action in compose must add the drafted note to shared notes state/context and then dismiss back to notes.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: handleSave calls `addNote(text)` (updating shared NotesContext state) and then `navigation.goBack()` to dismiss.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Navigator is constructed with `createNativeStackNavigator({...})` (static API) and rendered via `createStaticNavigation(Stack)`.
